trust_decision.summary: The decode step trusts the base64-decoded ciphertext to be at least aesGCMNonceSize (12) bytes before slicing the nonce off, and the decrypt handler trusts that a ciphertext field was supplied at all; both decisions are made at request-decode time in coordinator/internal/transitengineapi on data that an mTLS-authenticated workload fully controls.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names ciphertextContainer.UnmarshalJSON, and the fixed-offset slice fullCiphertext[:aesGCMNonceSize] is the first thing an engineer reads there.

fix_sites.entry_point: PUT /v1/transit/decrypt/{name} (HTTP, mTLS mesh client cert required)

fix_sites.module_kind: request struct definition (decoder schema; value -> pointer)
http handler (missing-field guard before keyVersion deref)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: coordinator/internal/transitengineapi/crypto.go:47-62 (symmetricDecryptRaw; its gcm.Open at crypto.go:57 panics on a non-12-byte nonce)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: symmetricDecryptRaw is unexported and has exactly one caller, the decrypt handler, whose input is already validated in UnmarshalJSON - so it is 'covered one layer up and not attacker-reachable'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Encrypting an empty plaintext is legitimate: Plaintext has no minimum length (transitengineapi.go:41), seal of an empty plaintext yields a tag-only 16-byte ciphertext (28 bytes after the 12-byte nonce), and that is exactly what this API's own encrypt endpoint returns. An over-broad 'decoded length must be greater than nonce+tag' guard in UnmarshalJSON would reject ciphertext this API produced.

O6_input_shapes: empty request body (no JSON at all) - already 400 via io.EOF before the fix
`{}` - ciphertext key absent, so UnmarshalJSON is never called and a zero-value container reaches gcm.Open with a 0-byte nonce
`"ciphertext": null` - decodes to a nil pointer without calling UnmarshalJSON
string with fewer than 3 colon-separated parts (`vaul`, `vault:v1`)
`vault:vX:<base64>` whose decoded length is under 12 bytes (truncated nonce)
`vault:vX:<base64>` decoding to 12+ bytes of random data - well-formed shape, GCM tag failure, must map to 400 rather than 500
non-string JSON value for ciphertext (number/array/object) - rejected by encoding/json into string

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second symmetric primitive in the same package (e.g. symmetricDecryptWithExplicitNonce, or a key-version-0 legacy decrypt) that parses its own container instead of calling UnmarshalJSON
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The package doc at transitengineapi.go:4-6 declares a deliberate two-layer split (http handling vs crypto business logic), and crypto.go already hosts two symmetric primitives; a second one for an explicit-nonce or wrapped-key import path is the natural next commit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new request field decoded the same way (e.g. a `wrapped_key` or client-supplied `nonce` for a v2 request shape) with its own fixed-offset parse
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The request structs already carry optional fields (associated_data, key_version) added incrementally against the upstream Vault/OpenBao transit spec documented at transitengineapi.go:107-109, so an added optional field is in character.

O9_family: Improper validation of an array index / unchecked slice bounds on attacker-controlled input leading to panic (CWE-129), plus a nil-pointer and a GCM nonce-size panic on the same route

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25.6 (go.mod:3); no vendor directory, so the first build needs module downloads, then works offline
O10_build.project_tests: coordinator/internal/transitengineapi/transitengineapi_test.go (TestTransitAPICyclic, httptest mux over getEncryptHandler/getDecryptHandler with a fake state guard) and crypto_test.go (TestCryptoCyclic); both are hermetic, no external services. e2e/vault/vault_test.go exercises the same API end to end but needs a Kubernetes cluster.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `if len(fullCiphertext) < aesGCMNonceSize` in UnmarshalJSON and stop - which still panics for `{}`/empty body (zero-value container reaches gcm.Open with a 0-byte nonce) and leaves the well-shaped-but-undecryptable case at 500 instead of 400.

out_of_scope_notes: nodeinstaller/internal/config/config.go:81,84 slices f.Integrity[:7] and nodeinstaller/internal/asset/fetcher.go:77,85,87 slices integrity[:7] with no length check - same unchecked-slice panic class but a different sink (SRI digest parsing), not this advisory's protection; noted only, not pursued.
internal/atls/atls.go:326,492 base64-decode client/server nonces but never slice at a fixed offset, so they are not a second implementation of this sink; noted while searching for one, not pursued.
